See also: pediatră and pediatrą

Galician

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /peˈdjatɾa/ [peˈð̞ja.t̪ɾɐ]
  • Rhymes: -atɾa

Noun

[edit]

pediatra m or f by sense (plural pediatras)

  1. paediatrician (physician who specialises in paediatrics)

Related terms

[edit]
  • pediatría
  • pediátrico

Further reading

[edit]
  • “pediatra”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026
  • “pediatra” in DIGALEGO - Dicionario de Galego, Ir Indo 2004, Xunta de Galicia 2013.
  • “pediatra”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From pedo- +‎ -iatra.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /peˈdja.tra/
  • Rhymes: -atra
  • Hyphenation: pe‧dià‧tra

Noun

[edit]

pediatra m or f by sense (masculine plural pediatri, feminine plural pediatre)

  1. pediatrician/paediatrician

Related terms

[edit]
  • pediatria

Further reading

[edit]
  • pediatra in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • derapati
